sentences.japanese: 私はいつも思っていた、心筋梗塞を患うことは死期を知らせる前兆だと。
sentences.english: I always thought that suffering a heart attack was an omen of death.

sentences.japanese: 日本では心臓病を患う人が多いようですが、リビアでも心筋梗塞になる人が最近とても増えています。
sentences.english: Many people suffer from heart disease in Japan, but in Libya those having heart attacks have also increased a lot recently.
Lay up for a rainy day.

sentences.japanese: 最近、肺結核を患う人はほとんどいない。
sentences.english: These days few people suffer from tuberculosis.

sentences.japanese: 妻は肺炎を患ってるんです。
sentences.english: My wife is suffering from pneumonia.
